precision exact: "exact" / "from source"
precision observed: "observed" / "no source time; observed live by nday"
precision day: "date only" / "date only, from source"
precision unknown: "" / "source gave no time"
T+ T+?: disclosure time unknown, cannot compute
T+ T+0d: 0 days after disclosure
T+ T+1d: 1 day after disclosure
T+ T+5d: 5 days after disclosure
T+ T-1d: 1 day before the CVE record was published
T+ T-20d: 20 days before the CVE record was published
strip: Lifecycle — disclosed: happened; public PoC: happened, time unknown; exploited in the wild: inferred from KEV; added to KEV: latest change
strip empty: Lifecycle — no events yet
